schema_note: Phase 1D-C observable-closure audit inventory, v1.1 (post-compliance-audit non-scientific cleanup). Every object under a *_conclusion key (and every entry of conclusion arrays) carries exactly: classification, source, assumptions, derivation_summary, convention_dependencies, implementation_consequence, evidence_needed_to_change_status. Classifications are exactly one of: VERIFIED_FROM_PRIMARY_SOURCE, DERIVED_FROM_VERIFIED_DEFINITIONS, NUMERICALLY_CORROBORATED, PROVISIONAL_MODEL_IMPORT, CONVENTION_DEPENDENT, REQUIRES_AUTHOR_INPUT, UNRESOLVED_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY, NOT_JUSTIFIED_FOR_OBSERVABLE_USE, FORBIDDEN_AS_A_SILENT_DEFAULT, NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence levels are never merged; supporting qualifications are listed inside convention_dependencies or assumptions. The top-level unresolved_dependencies category holds machine-readable reference records (id, dependency, status_summary, authoritative_paths) pointing to the authoritative conclusion objects elsewhere in this file or in the frozen phase inventories; reference records are not conclusion objects and deliberately carry no classification field, so no conclusion is duplicated or reclassified. Verbatim-quote records carry verbatim_status (descriptive source-record metadata), never classification. Companion prose: reports/phase1d_c_observable_closure_audit.md.
